body:
Local QUEST completion update (AUTHORING, no activation; follow-up to 5979811358). User requested the four remaining steps and explicitly kept work local/no PR. D531 was read; no branch publication or draft PR is performed in this run.

Root integrated six subagents and reconciled the candidate against exact accepted main `ad7a08f96caa4e7bd0e7fa90c67b39229d637277` without overwriting four newer Source-core changes in the older local canonical tree.

1. Authored68: all 416 chosen stage tracks/transitions projected, terminal completion declarations included. 133 exact target identity associations and 108 reward identity associations; NPC packet from #1757 gives 67 derived branch hints, of which 33 have literal Source evidence. These are not executable stage-to-NPC/reward bindings. Nine daily cycles retain explicit reset-binding holds.
2. Readiness242: all selected recipes data-complete and audited. Source flags are preserved: 187 still have Source/requirements/conflict limitations; groups overlap with execution holds. Fresh exact-main Item evidence reduces actual Item-admission dependencies from 21 quests to 19. Two i3081 Item-definition dependencies are resolved, but Mad Mage Room (Source argument 5, one instance with five charges) still needs instance lowering; Banshees (Source argument 1 versus definition five charges) retains SOURCE_CHARGE_MISMATCH.
3. Import: local `content/quests/missions/quest-state-completion-candidate.json` parses with the unchanged accepted Rust loader: 164 owners / 1746 tracks / 3679 transitions. SHA256 `8dc7aa8cc94b8679d66696d8e477880f86f29e3cd35bb7a2f3fae5403a2a22a5`. Five Source-proven same-track finite effects were refined using existing ADD; 387 unsupported transitions become 382, explicitly held. Production embedded input/lowerer unchanged.
4. Actual pure server-code qualification PASS: 32 unchanged module tests and all 68 chosen journeys, 13722 occurrences, 14002 predecessor bypass refusals, 416 extra-occurrence refusals. This is not gameplay, reward delivery or persistence qualification. PostgreSQL17.6 is available through cached Docker; durable writer/relog/restart was not run.

Remaining work should stay with existing NPC-QUEST-1 / NPC-QUEST-CONTENT-1 / QUEST-CONTENT-2 and domain writers: select exact NPC branches, install typed quest event/predicate/action consumers and data activation, connect atomic rewards including Item instance/charge handling and XP loader representation, qualify nine repeat resets, then player start→progress→reward→relog/restart. The inspected main has no production activation/caller for this loader path, and Dialogue DTO has no typed quest gate/effect fields. No duplicate store, worker allocation or architecture ruling is proposed. The remaining 382 transitions need justified semantics; guards were not weakened.

Full local run_checks.py exit 0: 919 unit tests (3 unchanged skips), 262 schema cases, RewardClaim 13+6 and all source/regeneration checks. 43 bounded new Python checks, independent reviews, governance/repository policy, 54 agent-policy tests and git diff --check PASS.

Artifacts are LOCAL ONLY in branch `codex/quest-data-completion-80-20261003`: completion candidate/binding-plan/receipt; `tools/content-schema/quest-authoring/samples/server-completion/`; `samples/state-effect-refinements/`; `docs/agents/evidence/OTV2-20261004-quest-completion-four-steps.{md,json}`. They are not downloadable from this comment or committed in main. All four gameplay goals are not claimed complete.
